Poly Haven models (https://polyhaven.com/models)

All models and textures in this folder are released by Poly Haven under CC0 1.0 Universal
(public domain dedication): https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
No attribution is required; they are credited in Docs/ASSET_CREDITS.md anyway.

Fetched by Tools/Art/fetch_models.py (FBX, colour and OpenGL normal maps as published; the
*_mask.png files are Poly Haven's ARM maps repacked for URP Lit by Tools/Art/pack_mask.py).
